name: xrp-wallet-messenger-extension
description: This Chrome extension dynamically scans web pages for XRP wallet addresses and provides functionalities to interact with these addresses directly through the context menu. Users can easily navigate to related XRP transactions or account details by right-clicking on detected addresses.

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const dir = 'dist'; if (fs.existsSync(dir)) { fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); } fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });"
scripts.minify:js: npx terser content.js -o dist/content.min.js --compress drop_console=true --mangle && npx terser options.js -o dist/options.min.js --compress drop_console=true --mangle
scripts.copy:assets: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); ['styles.css', 'option.gif', 'pin.gif', 'options.html', 'config.json', 'textrp_circle@7x.png'].forEach(file => { if (fs.existsSync(file)) { const dest = path.join('dist', file); fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest), { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync(file, dest); } });"
